questions.q: What is the official capital of Côte d'Ivoire?
questions.why: Abidjan is the economic capital.

questions.q: What is the largest city of Côte d'Ivoire?
questions.why: It is on the Ébrié Lagoon.

questions.q: From which country did Côte d'Ivoire gain independence in 1960?
questions.why: It is also called the Ivory Coast.

questions.q: Who was the first President of Côte d'Ivoire?
questions.why: He ruled from 1960 to 1993.

questions.q: Which crop is Côte d'Ivoire the world's largest producer of?
questions.why: It grows about 40% of the world's cocoa.

questions.q: What is the currency of Côte d'Ivoire?
questions.why: It is shared by eight countries.

questions.q: Who has been President of Côte d'Ivoire since 2010?
questions.why: He won a fourth term in 2025.

questions.q: Which huge basilica in Yamoussoukro copies St Peter's?
questions.a: Basilica of Our Lady of Peace
questions.why: It is one of the largest churches in the world.

questions.q: Which footballer helped stop the civil war with a 2005 speech?
questions.why: He begged both sides to lay down their arms.

questions.q: Which crisis followed the disputed 2010 election?
questions.why: Laurent Gbagbo refused to step down.

questions.q: Which former President was tried at the International Criminal Court?
questions.why: He was acquitted in 2019.

questions.q: Which city was the capital until 1983?
questions.why: Yamoussoukro was Houphouët's home town.

questions.q: Which old colonial capital near Abidjan is a UNESCO site?
questions.why: It was the first French capital.

questions.q: From which empire did Queen Abla Pokou lead the Baoulé people west?
questions.why: Legend says she sacrificed her son at a river.

questions.q: Which nationalist idea of 'Ivoirité' caused tension in the 1990s?
questions.why: It excluded many northerners.

questions.q: Which music and dance style from Abidjan became popular across Africa?
questions.why: It began in the 2000s.

questions.q: Which fermented cassava dish is a staple?
questions.why: It looks like couscous.

questions.q: Which fried plantain snack is sold in Abidjan's streets?
questions.why: It is served with chili and onion.

questions.q: Which open-air restaurants serve grilled fish and attiéké?
questions.why: They are found all over Abidjan.

questions.q: What is the national football team called?
questions.why: The elephant is a national symbol.

questions.q: In which year did Côte d'Ivoire win the Africa Cup of Nations on home soil?
questions.why: They had nearly been knocked out early.

questions.q: Which ocean is on Côte d'Ivoire's south coast?
questions.why: It has lagoons along the coast.

questions.q: Which national park in the west is home to wild chimpanzees?
questions.why: It is a UNESCO site.

questions.q: Which Ivorian midfielder won four Premier League titles with Manchester City?
questions.why: He was African Player of the Year four times.

questions.q: Which Ivorian reggae singer sang 'Brigadier Sabari'?
questions.why: He is one of Africa's top reggae stars.

questions.q: Which group sang '1er Gaou'?
questions.why: It became a hit in 2000.

questions.q: Which forest in Abidjan is a national park inside the city?
questions.why: It is a rare city rainforest.

questions.q: Which Ivorian sprinter won world indoor 60 m gold in 2018?
questions.why: She won it in Birmingham.

questions.q: Which Ivorian writer wrote 'Allah Is Not Obliged'?
questions.why: It is narrated by a child soldier.

questions.q: Which Ivorian taekwondo athlete won the country's first Olympic gold, in 2016?
questions.why: He won in the last second.
